summary: Destroys four singly-linked lists. The this object holds four head pointers (this[0..3]); for each non-null head the function walks the list via the next pointer stored at node offset 0x44 (element 17), freeing each node with FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Returns the final traversal pointer, which is NULL after a normal walk. Invoked from sub_4A4900.

operations.description: Iterate the four bucket heads this[0] through this[3].
Skip a bucket entirely when its head pointer this[i] is NULL.
Walk the current linked list, continuing while the current node is non-null.
Capture the next node from element 17 (offset 0x44) of the current node before it is freed.
Free the current node with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return the last traversal pointer (NULL after a fully walked list). The caller sub_4A4900 discards or ignores the result.

unresolved: Identity of the owning object and what the four buckets hold (free lists, hash buckets, allocation arenas) is not established.
The node next-pointer at element 17 (offset 0x44) implies a struct whose 0x44 field is the link, but the struct type is unknown.
The legacy name Arithmetic_Comparison_4a1f80 does not match the deallocation behavior and was not used for the proposal.
